scope.purpose: Resolve whether named-action taxonomy compression creates new historical product obligations.
scope.secondary_units: SMPFS-080, SMPFS-087 and SMPFS-073 were not reopened for adjudication because reviewer B confirmed they are contextual restatements, not genuinely disputed cases.

source_identity.identity_check: The two listed original-body spans are identical at the same line ranges in July.

ruling.confidence_reason: Retained explicit qualifications, source-preserving standardization language and unit preservation acceptance support a coherent whole-document reading. The unqualified canonical_text is still capable of a stronger detached reading.
ruling.decision: SMPFS-091 records the named-action taxonomy and preserves the June distinction between existing named actions and candidate/backlog families. Do not count its twelve category labels as twelve added implementation obligations.

plausible_readings.case: An accepted requirement whose canonical_text says the control plane is covering all twelve families can be read, in isolation, as an unconditional capability-coverage promise. The sentence omits backlog, Borrow-worthy and may borrow, and the compatibility-only/stale fields are empty. Canonical text can itself impose a requirement even without behavior-specific acceptance.
plausible_readings.limitation: No source in this bounded unit explicitly withdraws the retained qualifiers or declares the original body superseded. Empty compatibility fields do not override qualifications present in the canonical document. Several categories also overlap existing baseline obligations, so twelve labels would not prove twelve wholly new obligations.

plausible_readings.case: The preserved body still calls the action families backlog/Borrow-worthy and the taxonomy a reference shape PM may borrow. The conversion calls itself source-preserving and the unit requires preservation of source constraints, compatibility, owner boundaries and lineage. Named Browser Action Taxonomy, browser_action_taxonomy_drift and named_browser_action_taxonomy describe taxonomy scope rather than a newly specified behavior catalog. Existing canonical named-action examples remain binding within their existing scope.

field_adjudication.effect: Normative packaging and an ambiguous compressed assertion; not ignored. Read with the retained source qualifications rather than treating omitted qualifications as silently rescinded.

Addressability and preservation acceptance, plus a no-executable-work constraint. No new action-specific acceptance. Absence of behavior-specific acceptance alone does not neutralize normative prose; its affirmative preservation requirement is supporting evidence.

Preserves original boundary rules for web/read separation, prompt artifacts, reference Playwright material, opt-in test/debug, named actions, and effective-capability disclosure. It does not say every listed action category must ship, and it does not cancel research-session exclusions preserved elsewhere.
Both are empty. They do not contain the backlog qualifier, but emptiness supplies no explicit supersession of the qualifications still present in the document body.

Points to migration span S0047 and existing Contracts/Tools boundaries. The migration map and linked owner documents were not opened; links supply lineage/ownership context, not independent capability requirements or present approval.
Repeated action names are coverage/identity metadata, not extra obligations.

The retained source sections remain the document body. Source-preserving standardization preserves owner boundaries and behavior described by those sections; no local provision says the PlanUnit summary replaces their qualifying scope.

conditional_alternative_warning.text: If covering were intentionally meant to mandate all listed capabilities, separable missing action behaviors would require optional_capability analysis and independently chosen guarantees/default tiers/session support breadth would require product_decision analysis. None becomes necessary_correction merely because it is useful, hardened, prioritized, or named in a backlog. A twelve-label count would still be unsound: existing tab/wait/action/trace/PDF contracts overlap some labels, and composite labels could contain multiple distinct behaviors. No such promotion is established by the adopted contextual reading.

constraints_and_uncertainty.irreducible_uncertainty: Author intent behind the missing qualifiers in July canonical_text cannot be proved from these snapshots. A consumer reading only that field could interpret capability promotion. Record this as standalone wording ambiguity, not an established feature addition and not a license to implement optional families.
constraints_and_uncertainty.audit_completion_effect: No unresolved added-obligation atom is carried into the count for SMPFS-091. The ambiguity remains disclosed in this adjudication.

independent_review_coordination.b_initial_view: Twelve contingent optional-capability candidates, not settled additions; both readings plausible. Secondary 080/087/073 not genuinely disputed.
independent_review_coordination.counterevidence_response: Reviewer B reported no material counterevidence beyond the recorded standalone covering/accepted ambiguity and accepted the zero-addition contextual-restatement ruling.
